facts.fact: 医生来宣布死亡，她握着飞行员的大手不肯让位，近距离端详这个「最美的男人」
facts.anchor: even in this state he was the most beautiful man she’d ever seen

facts.fact: 她冒出坏心思：嘴对嘴吹气是反复吻他的完美借口
facts.anchor: realised it would be the perfect excuse to kiss him repeatedly on the mouth

facts.fact: Lawrenz 的情绪会在阴郁和残暴之间切换，她不信任这种反复无常
facts.anchor: His moods often turned into a sulk and then cruelty

facts.fact: Robertu 说 Lawrenz 总在讨父亲的夸奖，弟弟得了夸奖他就怨恨
facts.anchor: He’s always looking for praise, and he resents it if I get it instead of him

facts.fact: 秘密：Lawrenz 说他见过父亲打母亲，还不止一次
facts.anchor: Lawrenz said he has seen my father hitting my mother

facts.fact: 「尸体」咳出积水活了过来，她喜极而泣当作祈祷应验
facts.anchor: A miracle had occurred, and her pilot was alive

facts.fact: 他冲她眨眼，哑声说「你好，美人」「德国人抓不走我」
facts.anchor: No German’s going to get me

facts.fact: 临别赠言：历史是未来的钥匙，艺术使人自由——她把这句话带回家
facts.anchor: And art? Art will set you free
